params.caption: 🎮 Euro Truck Simulator 2 tops 100,000 concurrent players after 14 years A new DLC has pushed Euro Truck Simulator 2 past 100,000 concurrent players on Steam, 14 years after launch, leaving its developers in disbelief. Notably, it is non-trucking DLC that keeps drawing players back to the sim. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 01:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 🚚 React if you still drive in ETS2 · 💬 How many hours do you have? #EuroTruckSimulator2 #SCSSoftware #Steam #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
